title: The Fall of Man
buttonText: Show the stages of the fall
intro: Genesis 3 tells of humanity's greatest tragedy—the fall. Yet, in the midst of judgment shines the first promise of salvation: the proto-evangelium. Here we see the pattern of sin and God's gracious response.

items.title: The Serpent's Cunning
items.note: The devil's first tactic: sowing doubt about God's word

items.title: Eva Adds to God's Word
items.note: "Do not touch"—God did not say this (cf. 2:17)

items.title: The Serpent Lies
items.note: The first lie—to become like God

items.title: Three Stages of Temptation
items.note: See 1 John 2:16—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life

items.title: Eyes Opened—Shame
items.note: First attempt to cover up sin

items.title: "Where Are You?"
items.note: God seeks the sinner—the pattern of the gospel

items.title: The Proto-Evangelium
items.note: The first promise of the Messiah—the offspring of the woman (Christ) will triumph

items.title: God Clothes Them
items.note: The first sacrificial animal—blood shed to cover sin

footer.title: From Fall to Salvation
footer.content: The fall explains the world's condition—but also points to the solution. The offspring of the woman (Christ) crushed the serpent's head on the cross. And the way to the tree of life is open once more: {{Rev 2:7}}
